description: The protocol name table (docs/protocol.md, "Intent vocabulary"): the sixteen intents a protocol client may send, by exact, case-sensitive wire name. sendPrompt needs text that is not empty once trimmed of .whitespacesAndNewlines, and its prompt is the trimmed text; every other name ignores text. Voice capture (beginVoiceCapture, endVoiceCapture, pushToTalk, pushToTalkDraft) is never a protocol intent (HK-226), and no name grants escalation (HK-227): any name not in the table is refused, which the server answers with unknown_intent.
function: IntentMapper.intent(forProtocolName:text:) — input {name, text} (text a string or null), expected the intent descriptor ({"intent": <wire name>}, plus "prompt" for sendPrompt) or null when the name is refused
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.7, v2.11 C; docs/protocol.md spec v0; Tests/PowerUpTests/ProtocolFixtureTests.swift testIntentNameTable plays it through the bridge (CoreBridge.protocolIntent(name:text:)). Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/protocol.rs intent_name_cases runs protocol::message::intent_for_protocol_name.
